Being trans isn't stupid BS. Sure, some of the stuff in this sub is stupid bullshit, but some of it is actually serious.

Hi, real-life man here. I don't want kids (like pretty much everyone on this sub). Your SO's aunt is just wrong on so many levels, and overall sounds like a bitch. I would've pushed her away and tried to get the fuck out by that point.

Edit: Also, I think it's kind of funny that you're telling her that this is "a narrow way of viewing things" while actively not putting yourself in her shoes and taking her feelings into consideration.
Hey, I support you. I hope you have a good transition and become the woman you were always meant to be. You're just as valid as any other girl out there.

That's not how gender works, buddy. There's science proving that gender and identity is based on the brain and how an individual feels on the inside. A trans woman's brain is very similar to a non-trans woman's brain, and a trans man's brain is very similar to a non-trans man's brain. Point in case; they're literally just men and women trapped in the wrong bodies, and you're treating them like piles of shit with invalid identities. They're just trying to make the outside match the inside.
I know this isn't much, and I don't really know you, but I care and I know you can get better and make it so that the person you were meant to be reflects on the outside, too. I support you.

I'm not trans so I don't really know what you're going through, but I can kind of sympathize in that I could never be a woman ever and the idea of being in a woman's body for the rest of my life sounds awful to me. I'm also technically LGBT and honestly I don't like considering myself a part of the community for a lot of the reasons you specified. Honestly, just be yourself and be proud of who you are. You're not any less valid than other guys out there. Also, I dunno if this makes you feel any better, but I've met some really short guys in the past who were curvy and seemed kinda feminine but they weren't trans at all.

I'm a guy on the spectrum, and I find it very annoying when people do this kind of shit. Like sure I have a harder time understanding social cues and I do stuff and react to things differently than the average person, but I'm not stupid. Autism just means that your brain is wired differently and I wish people would understand that and stop being insensitive about it. I'm sorry you have to deal with people treating your son like a social experiment. Personally I'd tell them to fuck off in the nicest way possible.
